overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals elected Mike Caldera as its new chair and approved several residential development applications, including variances for a townhouse development on Elm Street, a third-floor addition on Pickard Street, and special permits for projects on Lincoln Street and Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Election of Board Chair
items.summary: Elected Mike Caldera as the Zoning Board of Appeals chair for the upcoming year.

items.title: 106 Alexander Avenue
items.summary: Acknowledged the applicant's written request to withdraw the petition to construct a two-family home without opening the case.

items.title: 85 Elm Street
items.summary: Approved use and dimensional variances to demolish a nonconforming motor vehicle repair station and construct a three-unit townhouse.

items.title: 31 Lincoln Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit for a second curb cut to allow off-street parking.

items.title: 121 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a special permit for an eight-foot high fence around a transformer and emergency generator enclosure at the Medford Housing Authority senior housing complex.

items.title: 46 Pickard Street
items.summary: Approved a variance for height and a special permit to extend a nonconforming side yard setback to construct a third floor on an existing two-family home.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Discussed the ongoing search for a seventh board member and plans to utilize AI software to draft outstanding meeting minutes.
